skills.name: research-writing-assistant:brainstorming-research

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:environment-setup
skills.description: Use when Python environment setup is needed for data visualization or conda installation is required

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:evidence-driven-writing
skills.description: Use when writing or revising Introduction, Related Work, background, literature synthesis, or any section where references must drive claims

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:experiment-results-planning
skills.description: Use when designing experiments, result tables, mock planning data, evaluation protocols, or results sections before real data are final

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:figures-diagram
skills.description: Use when creating flowcharts, architecture diagrams, or conceptual diagrams - generates prompts for image AI

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:figures-python
skills.description: Use when creating data visualizations for papers - generates publication-quality plots with top-journal color schemes

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:latex-output
skills.description: Use when user requests LaTeX format output or has provided school/journal LaTeX templates

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:literature-review
skills.description: Use when writing literature review sections - guides searching, organizing, and synthesizing academic sources

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-academic-search
skills.description: Search literature across sources, verify or manage citations, and build MeSH strategies or citation-impact audits. Use for 文献检索、引文核对、参考文献管理、严格他引 and evidence-backed citer profiles; not for translating a paper or drafting manuscript prose.

interface.shortDescription: Search and verify scholarly literature across sources
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-academic-search to search for relevant literature and verify every citation across independent sources.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-figure
skills.description: Create, revise, audit, and export manuscript scientific figures in Python or R. Use for 论文配图、科研绘图、多面板图 and submission-ready plots, or explicitly requested AI-generated graphical abstracts and mechanism schematics. Not for interactive dashboards, data cleaning, or statistics-only analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Create and audit submission-ready scientific figures
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-figure to create and audit a submission-ready scientific figure from these data.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-paper-card
skills.description: Build a structured deep-reading Paper Card for one scientific paper, analysing methods, experiment-to-claim evidence, limitations, and research ideas. Use for 论文精读卡、方法拆解、证据链分析; not full-paper bilingual translation or formal peer review.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-paper-card to turn this paper into a source-grounded Sections 01-16 deep-reading Paper Card.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-paper-xray
skills.description: Read one supplied paper closely enough to reconstruct how its authors actually got there, rather than restating what the abstract claims. Use for 精读论文, 讲透这篇论文, 把这篇读懂, 作者为什么这么设计, 这个公式怎么推出来的, paper x-ray, and deep single-paper comprehension before building on, reviewing, presenting, or citing that paper. Recovers the real starting point and the bet the authors placed, separates load-bearing design from decoration, grounds each key formula in a worked micro-example with concrete numbers, and checks how far the evidence actually reaches, including where the authors are confident and where the paper does not report something. Delivers a structured Markdown long-read by default. Not a summary, not a translation, not a peer review.

interface.shortDescription: Reconstruct how a paper's authors actually got there
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-paper-xray to read this paper closely: reconstruct the authors' real starting point and the bet they placed, separate load-bearing design from decoration, ground the key formulas in worked examples, and check how far the evidence reaches.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-polishing
skills.description: Polish, translate, or tighten existing academic prose while preserving facts, terminology, and evidence boundaries. Use for 论文润色、学术翻译、正文精简, or manuscript LaTeX layout fixes. Use nature-writing when the main task is drafting new sections or rebuilding the manuscript argument.

interface.shortDescription: Polish academic prose while preserving factual meaning
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-polishing to revise this passage into concise Nature-leaning English without changing its factual meaning.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-reader
skills.description: Create source-grounded Chinese-English paper readers with aligned text, figures, tables, and equations. Use for 全文翻译、中英文对照、论文精读 or source-linked questions about a paper; respect a requested excerpt or question without generating a full reader.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-reader to build a Chinese-English, figure-aware reader for this paper.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-ref-verifier
skills.description: 对学术文献逐条执行多源交叉验证，逐字段对比作者、标题、年份、卷期、页码， 标记卷年/DOI年冲突、作者顺序异常、页码偏差等问题，输出结构化验证报告。 可批量处理整篇论文/开题报告的参考文献列表，也可单条校验，支持与 Zotero 同步修正。

interface.shortDescription: Verify scholarly references across independent sources
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-ref-verifier to verify every field of these references across independent scholarly sources.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-reviewer
skills.description: Provide evidence-grounded mock peer review of scientific manuscripts or excerpts, covering significance, validity, and major/minor concerns. Use for 模拟审稿、投稿前自审、审稿人视角评估; not author rebuttal drafting.

interface.shortDescription: Simulate tiered, mutually blind pre-submission reviews
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-reviewer to run three mutually blind pre-submission reviews with tiered Major and Minor comments.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-shared
skills.description: Internal shared-reference support package for installed Nature Skills, including nature-writing, nature-polishing, nature-response, nature-reader, and nature-paper2ppt. Do not invoke it as a standalone user workflow. Load only the specific core or journal-format file requested by another Nature skill.

interface.shortDescription: Shared references for dependent Nature Skills only
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-shared only as a support package requested by another Nature Skill.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:nature-writing
skills.description: Draft or restructure scientific manuscript arguments, sections, and initial-submission materials from author-provided evidence. Use for 论文写作、章节起草、论证重构、正文压缩、首次投稿材料. Use nature-polishing for language-only edits to existing prose and nature-response for post-decision correspondence.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $nature-writing to draft a Nature-style manuscript section or initial-submission package from these materials.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:paper-orchestration
skills.description: Use when a research-writing task spans multiple sections, medium-sized revisions, full-paper drafting, or repeated quality failures

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:peer-review
skills.description: Use before submission or when reviewing papers - provides evaluation checklists, bias detection, and self-review templates

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:prompts-collection
skills.description: Use for translation, polishing, or de-AI-ification of academic text - provides ready-to-use prompt templates

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:statistical-analysis
skills.description: Use when planning or reporting statistical analysis - provides test selection, execution code, and APA format guidelines

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:using-research-writing
skills.description: Use when starting any research writing task - establishes workflow and routes to appropriate skills

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:verification
skills.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, a chapter is finished, or references are verified - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:writing-chapters
skills.description: Use when writing paper chapters - requires completed brainstorming, writes one chapter at a time with user confirmation

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:writing-core
skills.description: Use when writing or revising academic papers, especially Chinese journal manuscripts, that need natural prose, de-AI-ification, Markdown formatting, or quality checks

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:writing-humanities
skills.description: Use when writing humanities or social science papers - provides discipline-specific writing guidance

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:writing-law
skills.description: Use when writing law papers - provides legal writing conventions, citation formats, and argumentation guidance

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:writing-medical
skills.description: Use when writing medical, biological, or clinical research papers - provides IMRaD structure and reporting guidelines

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:imagegen
skills.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images for websites, games, and more
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $imagegen to make or edit an image for this project.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:openai-docs
skills.description: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex.
skills.shortDescription: Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, and self-knowledge; OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT Work. 'You'/'this app' means Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: OpenAI and Codex docs for models, skills, tasks, and setup
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenAI Docs for official docs lookup, questions about Codex itself or Codex surfaces, model selection, model migration, and prompt-upgrade work.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:review-agent
skills.description: Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Find actionable bugs in code changes
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $review-agent to review the requested code changes and return actionable findings.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:skill-creator
skills.description: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources.

skills.name: research-writing-assistant:skill-installer
skills.description: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos).
skills.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos

interface.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos
